The execution successfully addressed the core challenges of HWPX manipulation: handling fragmented placeholders across multiple XML tags and preventing rendering artifacts by removing layout caches. 

Key logic used:
1. Concatenated all text nodes (`<hp:t>`) within a paragraph (`<hp:p>`) before performing string replacement to handle cases where `{{` and `}}` are split.
2. Removed `<hp:lineSegArray>` elements in modified paragraphs to force the HWP viewer to recalculate layout, avoiding overlapping text.
3. Flattened JSON keys to match the `{{key}}` pattern in the template.

This pattern—Concatenate -> Replace -> Clear Siblings -> Remove lineSegArray—is the reliable standard for HWPX template filling.
